title: _claimRewards underflows and reverts after pauseWithdraw -> unpause -> claim sequence, bricking the user's reward-claim and normal withdraw paths

knownIssueCheck.candidate: KI-4 'pauseWithdraw does NOT claim rewards or update pool (emergency exit mechanism by design)'
knownIssueCheck.rationale: KI-4 acknowledges rewards are not claimed during the pauseWithdraw call itself. This finding is about the SUBSEQUENT permanent revert (Solidity 0.8 underflow Panic 0x11) when the user tries to claim/withdraw/stake AFTER the pause-withdraw cycle. Stale debt vs reduced principal is a downstream defect, not the by-design forfeiture.

oosCheck.rationale: src/Phlimbo.sol is the canonical audit target.
